headline: LinkedIn shifts annual bonuses to individual performance from FY27
summary: Starting in fiscal year 2027, LinkedIn will base its annual corporate bonus payouts entirely on individual performance, eliminating the 50% company-wide performance component currently used. The Microsoft-owned platform aims to create a more direct link between rewards and personal contributions, aligning with a broader tech industry trend toward individual accountability. The revised policy applies to corporate bonus programs and excludes sales staff whose compensation remains tied to quotas.

headline: US suspends Microsoft’s access to green card sponsorship programme
summary: The US administration has suspended Microsoft, Adobe, and several IT services firms from the labor-certification program used to sponsor foreign workers for green cards, citing investigations into hiring practices. While the decision restricts companies from aiding foreign talent in obtaining permanent residency, it does not prevent them from employing standard H-1B visa holders. The move signals a broader tightening of US business immigration policies that could impact long-term corporate talent retention strategies.

headline: Google’s Gemini AI steps into the workplace; has its own email address
summary: Google Cloud has launched an autonomous Gemini AI workplace agent designed to function as a persistent digital coworker across platforms like Gmail, Microsoft 365, and Slack. Operating under its own identity, the system can execute complex workflows, spawn temporary sub-agents, and route jobs across models from both Google and Anthropic. This shift toward hybrid human-AI teams introduces pressing managerial challenges regarding liability, performance tracking, and organizational design.

headline: The workplace perk that costs almost nothing
summary: Low-cost workplace perks centered around managerial discretion, flexibility, and trust often have a greater impact on employee satisfaction than traditional benefits programs. HR leaders highlight that granting staff autonomy to manage personal responsibilities fosters reciprocal commitment and team resilience. Ultimately, embedding empathy into daily management practices builds trust and productivity without requiring significant corporate spending.

headline: Jombay has elevated Tanvi Chaturvedi to CEO after 9 years
summary: HR services firm Jombay has appointed Tanvi Chaturvedi as its new Chief Executive Officer following her long-standing leadership tenure with the company. Chaturvedi, who has served in key roles including Chief Psychologist and Head of Talent Advisory, had been acting as CEO-designate since August. In her new capacity, she will focus on enhancing Jombay's AI-driven talent intelligence and assessment solutions across the employee lifecycle.

headline: Chinese restaurant owner gifts BMWs to top-performing employees
summary: A beef hotpot restaurant chain owner in Henan, China, surprised several top-performing employees by gifting them fully paid brand-new BMW cars. Driven by concern over her staff's harsh daily commutes on electric scooters during cold and rainy weather, the owner bought the vehicles, valued at roughly 300,000 yuan each. The gesture has gained online attention as an unconventional approach to performance recognition and employee welfare.

headline: Shivani Hazari moves from leadership advisory to group head HR at Jindal Steel
summary: Shivani Hazari has been appointed as Group Head of Human Resources at Jindal Steel after serving over three years in a senior leadership advisory role within the group. With more than two decades of executive search and leadership experience at firms including Sheffield Haworth and EWK International, she will now oversee talent development and broader HR strategy across Jindal's diverse industrial portfolio.
